objective: Test whether the quadratic interaction subspace is generated by frontier-relative residual incidence: preserve which delayed residual cells share local columns while quotienting away absolute component elevation.
clue_from_parent: DELAY preserves the full quadratic interaction span on 5x3-k3 and 6x3-k3.
DELAY captures only 398 of 422 interaction dimensions on 4x4-k4 and leaves 94 scalar contradictions.
Adding the sorted height multiset changes neither rank nor contradictions on 4x4-k4.
Therefore the next missing coordinate is tested as residual/column incidence correlation rather than raw height.
new_descriptors: REL_INC: canonicalize under local column permutations after replacing each residual cell row by depth above its current column frontier; preserve residual hyperedge identity, owner, and shared-column incidence.
CAP6_REL_INC: REL_INC plus remaining local component capacity modulo 6.
CAP_REL_INC: REL_INC plus exact remaining local component capacity.
anti_circularity: New descriptors are motivated only by the structural rank deficit between DELAY and EXACT, not by W/D/L labels.
Residual hyperedge identity and gravity depths are computed solely from the current RFG component.
Outcome labels do not define or refine any descriptor.
targets: whether REL_INC closes the 24-dimensional 4x4-k4 structural rank deficit
whether local capacity contributes anything beyond frontier-relative incidence
decoder contradictions on all three carriers
pair-catalog compression relative to exact component identity
falsifiers: If REL_INC and its capacity variants fail to recover the full 4x4-k4 interaction rank, frontier-relative incidence is incomplete.
If a descriptor recovers full rank but leaves scalar contradictions, the harness is inconsistent.
If EXACT fails its established control, the experiment is mechanically invalid.
next_if_success: Freeze the smallest successful frontier-relative descriptor and qualify it on a fresh tall-board holdout before deriving a closed-form interaction coefficient law.
next_if_fail: Add one outcome-independent incidence invariant at a time, beginning with residual-intersection topology or column-local participation signatures; do not restore exact IDs wholesale.
